sections.element: Order of Mass and minister roles
sections.expected: For Monday 2027-01-11, neither Gloria nor Creed is ordinarily appointed (GIRM 53,68). They follow Roman calendar day and season: Sundays outside Advent/Lent ordinarily have both; Sundays of Advent/Lent Creed only; solemnities both; feasts Gloria only. Particular solemn celebrations can differ.
sections.note: v460 source/renderer comparison: USCCB GIRM 53/68 vs Ora selected day rank and season. Before correction, the private Missal preview displayed Gloria and Apostles’ Creed whenever the book contained them, even on ordinary weekdays. Ora now omits unappointed parts on a matched Memorial weekday and uses the Nicene Creed on an ordinary Sunday while exposing the saved Apostles’ Creed as an explicitly collapsed alternative. Dated Node selections cover Monday 2027-01-11, Ordinary Sunday 2026-11-15, Advent Sunday 2026-12-13, Lent Sunday 2027-03-07, solemnity 2026-12-08, feast 2027-02-02, and Boston Thursday Ascension 2027-05-06; browser uses a synthetic local EPUB with matched weekday and Sunday sections, without real book text. This checks rubrics/selection only, not exact approved Missal wording. Particular Ritual/Votive or more solemn Masses and local calendar choices may lawfully differ.

sections.element: Examination, psalmody, reading, responsory, Nunc Dimittis, collect, blessing and Marian antiphon
sections.expected: Ordinary Monday Night Prayer: Psalm 86 (Vulgate 85); 1 Thessalonians 5:9–10; responsory; Nunc Dimittis; Monday collect, blessing and Marian antiphon, with allowed alternatives.
sections.note: For 2027-01-11, compared Ora's selected Monday weekday plan and actual rendered Compline order with DivineOffice.org's First Edition Monday Night Prayer witness (Vol. III, p. 1275) and GILH 84–92. Psalm 86 (Vulgate 85) and 1 Thessalonians 5:9–10 match the source appointments. The examination is optional, psalm and Nunc Dimittis antiphons repeat, and the responsory, collect, blessing and Marian antiphon occur in order. Ora marks its psalm and short reading as Douay–Rheims and its hymn as historical English; those are not certified U.S. First Edition translations. GILH 88 permits Sunday psalms as an alternative, and GILH 92 permits multiple Marian antiphons outside Easter; Ora shows the Monday psalm and Salve Regina rather than an exhaustive option picker. Exact official wording, authorized hymn choice, collected prayer text, full seasonal variants and local calendars still need comparison against the approved book. Browser/Node regression covers structure/labels, not licensed-text identity.
